The Bhaal Temple is closed off by a massive door. They are 3 ways to open the door.1) with an Bhaal Amulet, given in the Serial Killer situation2) with invitation from Orin - which is given when players killed Gortash, after she has given the players the ultimatum3) if players are the Dark Urge, their butler will freely open the doors for the players.

context: The party is standing before the magically sealed main door of the Bhaal Temple, with Sceleritas Fel — an obsequious butler/door-guardian who presents himself as Bhaal’s servant — blocking entry. The door will not open by ordinary means: it accepts either a Bhaal Amulet (obtained in the Serial Killer encounter), an invitation Orin grants after the player kills Gortash and accepts her ultimatum, or automatic access if the player is the Dark Urge (in which case the butler/attendant will open it). Sceleritas alternates between fawning reverence, mocking cruelty, and a willingness to die to serve, and he will refuse entry unless one of those keys or statuses is produced. Companions (e.g., Minsc, Jaheira) are unsettled by the temple’s violent history, and nearby disturbances have already drawn local troublemakers off-screen.
